definition: Assume that something is the case on the basis of evidence or probability.
exampleSentence: Suppose you had an opportunity to work abroad, would you relocate immediately?

definition: Likely to happen or be the case.
exampleSentence: If weather conditions deteriorate further, flight cancellations are probable.

definition: Form a mental image or concept of.
exampleSentence: If I won a round-the-world cruise ticket, I would invite my closest companions.

definition: On the condition or understanding that.
exampleSentence: You will pass the driving assessment comfortably provided that you stay calm.

definition: A thing that is caused or produced by something else.
exampleSentence: If you practice consistently, a positive result is guaranteed.
